Amazon Prime Day Deals that are Actually Good (Ends October 7)

Last updated: October 7, 2026 G.E. Miller 2 Comments
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 8:19
Instaread

Amazon’s “Prime Big Deal Days” is back October 6th and 7th (end of day). I’m not a year-long Prime member, however, I do usually sign up for an Amazon Prime Trial around Prime Days and pay close attention to Prime Day deals in order to share the best deals that I see with readers. A lot of the “deals” that you’ll find on Prime Days aren’t spectacular, but there are usually a few that I deem to be worthy of sharing with readers.




Below, you’ll find the best of what I’m seeing so far (I’ll update if I see anything else that stands out). This article contains some Amazon affiliate links (thank you for supporting this site if you use them). If you see any great deals that I missed, feel free to share in the comments.

The Best Prime Day Credits & Offers

Get Free Amazon Prime or 3 Months of Prime for $7.49/month: your offer may vary.

All Prime Day Deals: if you’d like to see all Prime Day deals, this is where to start.

Top 100 Prime Day Deals: according to Amazon.

Today’s Big Deals (deals that only run on a given day)




Amazon Prime Visa: get a $150 Amazon gift card when you are approved. No spend required. I’ve written about this Amazon Prime Visa Card offer and included a review.

“Lightning” Deals and “Doorbuster” Deals

$15 off $50 on Household Essentials (Code: STOCKUPSAVE)

$30 Amazon credit on $100 of baby items (Code: BABYDEALDAYS): get a $30 Amazon credit after spending $100 on select baby items with code.




“Buy Again” Prime Day Deals: takes you to your “buy again” page to see if any items you’ve previously purchased (and might want to purchase again) have a Prime Day deal attached to them.

Amazon Shopping Cart: also a good idea to check your shopping cart and scroll down to see any saved items that are on sale.

Gift Card Deals: a list of any gift card deals during Prime Day, with some up to 20% off.

Amazon Haul: 30% off sitewide, + an extra 10% off $75+, + free shipping on $25+

Amazon Music Unlimited: get 3 months free.

Audible Premium Plus: 3 months for $0.99 + a $20 Audible credit

Amazon Autos: buy or lease a new car from Amazon Autos and get a $1,500 Amazon gift card.

Amazon Discounts for Shopping with Points (Your Mileage May Vary):

Amazon and Chase are currently running a promo to get a $150 Amazon gift card when you are approved for the Amazon Prime Visa.

Separately, you can sometimes get discounts for adding eligible new cards and paying with points from credit card member point programs. These offers stack on top of any other discounts. I’m not sure if all of these are live at this exact moment as they are targeted to specific users periodically, but it’s worth a check to see if you’re eligible. Check out my Amazon discounts article for more details on these types of offers.

  • American Express Membership Rewards Points (or this one)
  • Citi Thank You Points
  • Capital One Rewards Points
  • Chase Ultimate Rewards Points
  • Discover Points
  • U.S. Bank Rewards Points

Make sure you have linked your respective card as a form of payment and then go back to click the links above to see if you are targeted with the promotion (pro tip: sometimes it helps to un-enroll and then re-enroll the card if you’ve used a promotion previously). You can enroll a card at these links: American Express, Capital One, Chase, Citi, Discover, and U.S. Bank. You can un-enroll a card by going to your payments page in your wallet (select the card, then choose “edit” and “remove from wallet”) and then re-enroll the card to try again.
